description: Na₇Fe₃O₈ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are seven inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and edges with three NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.53 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.94 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with three NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.30 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three FeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, edges with three NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.60 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.70 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with six FeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.30 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.52 Å. There are three inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and corners with three NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-1.93 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with four NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with three NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-1.99 Å. In the third Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and corners with three equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-1.94 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Fe atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 16°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Fe atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Fe atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Fe atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Fe atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-16°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 15°. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 14°. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Fe atom.
